title: ROG: A Multi-Layer Manually Annotated Corpus of Spoken Slovenian
reason: ROG builds on the pre-existing Spoken Slovenian Treebank and GOS 2 recordings. Its new manual prosodic/disfluency/dialogue layers are linguistically useful but the underlying recordings are secondary; do not admit as primary production core unless a genuinely new primary-recording component can be isolated.

title: NonSpeech7k
reason: Human nonspeech clips are sourced from FreeSound/YouTube/Aigei and are third-party media/non-speech rather than primary phonetic production collected by the study.

title: CASTELLA: Long Audio Dataset with Captions and Temporal Boundaries
reason: Manual temporal annotation targets generic audio moments/captions rather than primary speech-production phonetics; source is an audio-retrieval benchmark.
